generation.scope: Every standard indexed window with a regular normal linear sequence has exact period one. Marked classes correspond to central homogenizations of PBW deformations of ternary standard Koszul AS algebras, with an explicit three-condition test and affine change-of-lifts rule. For a smooth plane cubic quotient the normal sequence is intrinsically unique, yielding the full unmarked test. Over a fixed smooth elliptic Sklyanin quotient all special classes form a split point and a finite quotient of weighted projective space P(1,1,1,2,2,2), of dimension five.

open_mathematics: Extend intrinsic recognition of normal linear sequences to singular cubic quotients and to tensors without a supplied mark; determine overlap with other branches. Resolve the simultaneous two-pair quantum obstructions and the remaining windows without a quantum or normal-line description.
